cards.title: The Bug This Flow Used to Have
items: Anchoring on COMPLETED volume meant a busy week shrank the next one
Bounds in km, recomputed from a pace the athlete might not run, distorted the target
Both are fixed: the anchor is always PLANNED minutes now, never completed-only

cards.title: Adherence Is a Signal, Not a Punishment
items: Below 80% completion the week HOLDS near the prior plan (0.95-1.02x)
The model is told to frame a held week as a repeat, not a setback
100% completion still doesn't guarantee growth -- the request's own precedence rule decides

cards.title: Single-Week Scope
items: target_week pins block_start_week = block_end_week = N inside the generator
Every other week in the plan is untouched by this flow
preserve_completed=True means an already-logged session in week N survives regeneration
